title: Intersection subspaces and inverse-image structure-sheaf sections
statement: For a scheme $X$ [def-pc-scheme] and an index type $I$, with opens $U_i\subseteq X$, let $E=\{x\in |X|\mid \forall i,\ x\in U_i\}$ with its subspace topology. Define the inclusion $j:E\hookrightarrow X$, the inverse-image sheaf $\mathcal O_X|_E=j^{-1}\mathcal O_X$ [def-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image], its section ring $\Gamma(E,\mathcal O_X|_E)$, and for every open $V\subseteq X$ containing $E$ the canonical restriction homomorphism $\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_X)\to\Gamma(E,\mathcal O_X|_E)$ induced by the inverse-image adjunction unit.
